ContentLocation.description: The canonical address of the resource, sent when the request used a name or an old name.

ETag.description: The tag of this answer. For the type registry it is made from the model hash and the query.

TraceId.description: The trace id of the request; the same as meta.trace_id or trace_id in the body.

Cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Send the same filter and sort again.
Cursor.name: cursor

IdempotencyKey.description: A unique string made by the client; required on creating POSTs and actions. The same key and body replay the first answer.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

IfMatch.description: The ETag of the version you read; required on PATCH, DELETE and actions that change an item (412 when it no longer matches, 428 when missing).
IfMatch.name: If-Match

IfNoneMatch.description: The ETag of a copy you hold; the server answers 304 when it is still current.
IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match

Limit.description: The page size; default 100, at most 1000.
Limit.name: limit

BadRequest.description: The request is wrong: an unknown or invalid query parameter, filter, sort, fields, include or cursor.

Conflict.description: The cursor belongs to another generation of the model; read the list again from the start.

Forbidden.description: The caller is logged in but holds no role that may do this.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path has no such method.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller (the two look alike).

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is larger than the limit.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match no longer matches the current version.

PreconditionRequired.description: The request needs an If-Match header.

ServerError.description: The server failed; the trace id finds the log line.

TooManyRequests.description: A limit was exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds.

Unauthorized.description: The caller is not logged in or the token is not accepted.

Unavailable.description: The server is not ready to take work.

ActionType.description: An action type with its four risk axes.

applies_to.description: The targets the action applies to.

physical.description: Whether it acts on the physical world.

superseded_by.description: The action type that replaces it.

AllowedAction.description: One action the caller may or may not do, with the reason when not.

action.description: The action name, such as edit.

allowed.description: Whether the caller may do it now.

reason_code.description: Why not, from GET /v1/catalog/reason-codes; null when allowed.

AsOf.description: Which state of which KG an answer reads (KG answers only).

change_seq.description: The last change number the answer includes.

generation.description: The generation, which rises on every point-in-time restore.

sealed_version.description: The sealed KG version, when the answer reads one.

volatile_as_of.description: Whether volatile values are current or omitted.

Binding.description: One pair of ends a link type may join.

param_constraints.description: The values this binding accepts for a parameter of the meaning.

BindingList.description: The bindings of one link type.

BoundLink.description: A binding with the link type it belongs to.

states.description: The values the channel can have.

Endpoint.description: One end of a binding or one target of an action.

ref.description: The id of the type or the trait; null for any.

ErrorCode.description: One error code of the closed catalogue.

ErrorCodeList.description: The closed catalogue of error codes.

Evidence.description: The grade of the facts behind an answer (KG answers only).

counts.description: How many facts of each grade.

min_grade.description: The lowest grade used: fact, assumed or unknown.

FieldError.description: One wrong field of a request.

code.description: The code of this field's problem.

params.description: The values a screen needs to write the message.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the field, or the query parameter name.

Freshness.description: How old the sources of an answer are (KG answers only).

oldest_age_seconds.description: The age of that data in seconds.

state.description: The worst state among the sources.

worst_source_id.description: The source with the oldest data.

HealthLive.description: The answer of a liveness probe.

HealthReady.description: The answer of a readiness probe.

model_hash.description: The hash of the loaded model.

Hidden.description: Whether the caller's scope hid something from the answer.

normalizer.description: The value type that tidies the value.

IdentityKey.description: One identity key of a type, in priority order.

scheme.description: The identifier scheme, when the key is an external identifier.

allowed_actions.description: What the caller may do with this resource now. A hint for screens; the server judges again on every request.

model_hash.description: The hash of the model the answer was read from; the ETag is made from it.

trace_id.description: The trace id, the same as the X-Trace-Id header.

KeyComponent.description: One component of an identity key.

incoming.description: Whether the context is read against the link direction.

ref.description: The property or context the component names.

size.description: The size of a set component; 0 otherwise.

type_count.description: How many object types it holds.

from_channel.description: The channel of the start that depends.

to_channel.description: The channel of the end it depends on.

meaning.description: One of the eleven closed meanings.

values.description: The allowed values of an enum.

standard_ref.description: The standard the type follows, if any.

traits.description: The traits the type carries itself.

expires_at.description: When the job and its result disappear, UTC.

errors.description: One entry per wrong field of the input.

params.description: The values a screen needs to write the message.

trace_id.description: The trace id, the same as the X-Trace-Id header.

ProblemAnswer.description: The explanation of one error code.

Property.description: One property of a type, a trait or a link type.

change_class.description: How the value changes: static, slow or volatile.

enum_values.description: The allowed values of an enum.

required.description: Whether an object must have it.

scope_key.description: Whether the property is a scope key.

unit.description: The unit of the value, when it has one.

value_type.description: The id of the value type.

ReasonCode.description: One reason an action is refused.

ReasonCodeList.description: The reasons an action is refused.

ResultComplete.description: How much of a list this answer holds (rest-api.md 3-2, 3-3).

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

reason.description: Why it was cut, when truncated.

returned.description: How many items this page holds.

total.description: How many items match the filter, without those hidden from the caller.

truncated.description: Whether the answer was cut by a limit other than the page size.

Role.description: One role and what it may do.

abilities.description: The abilities of the role table.

ServedBy.description: Which role of the product answered.

Trait.description: A trait with the types that carry it.

carriers.description: The types that carry the trait, their own or inherited.

TraitSummary.description: A trait: a set of properties and needs many types share.

TypeRef.description: A short reference to a type.

ValueType.description: A value type a property can have.

builtin.description: Whether it is a base type itself.

bearerAuth.description: A bearer token. The identity backend that issues tokens is not built yet; a development token exists for development only (ADR-0024).
